about: Real stop places from the 6 diagnostics exports of 2026-10-14 (SNAPSHOT jobs + distanceTable) plus the J74 marker case. resolve_checks.mjs resolves every row with resolveStopPlace (roster = data/uex/locations.json + other-positions.json) and checks expect. expect.name = the roster place the stop resolves to (match, or site for a generic site); maxMeters = the resolved point's furthest allowed distance from that place. expect null = not decided (reported, not tested). A new problem = a new row.
